## Summary

On 2026-09-01 (~12:00–16:00 PT) the Gerrit `LLM-Review` bot on host `i-00880b2c7f13527c5` (`rebar-gerrit`) fail-closed every review because clones/materializations hit `No space left on device` on the 30 GiB root disk (91–95% used), producing `VOTER_ERROR` / `coverage-gap (review-error)` vetoes. Change 2481 exhausted its retry budget to a fail-closed LLM-Review −1; 2479/2480/2482/2483 deferred. Recovery required EC2 reboot plus manual `docker builder prune -f` without `--keep-storage`, dropping disk use from ~95% to ~74%.

This is a **defect escape** of the same fail-closed-on-full-disk class as closed 2731-4c53, 7a41-95f4, 3a52-2d79, 9bc0-1200, 28f9-535c, and e2c5-f09b.

## Evidence

Pre-prune on-box `docker system df` showed: Build Cache 5.244 GB (100% reclaimable, dominant consumer), Images 2.802 GB all active (9bc0/2340 image-retirement is working), Containers 3.572 GB, Local Volumes 947 MB, and snapshot store 1.4 GB.

## Approved design

The operator approved BOTH parts on 2026-09-01; this ticket is implementation work, not an architecture decision.

### Part A — acute-pressure emergency reclaim tier

Keep the existing steady-state warm BuildKit cache (`BUILD_CACHE_KEEP=5GB`) for normal pressure pruning. Add `DISK_PRESSURE_HARD_PCT` (default 90, above soft `DISK_PRESSURE_PCT=80`). When root used-% is at or above the hard threshold, escalate `prune_docker_caches()` to `docker builder prune -f` with keep→0 (no `--keep-storage`). The action remains best-effort/non-fatal and timeout-bounded like existing docker prune calls. It must compute before/after root filesystem bytes and log bytes actually freed; an invocation marker alone is not success evidence. At normal disk levels it must keep using `--keep-storage "$BUILD_CACHE_KEEP"`.

### Part B — near-full review admission control

Add a target-path free-space helper in `src/rebar/_snapshot/janitor.py` (wrapping `shutil.disk_usage(path)`) so admission checks measure the volume that can ENOSPC, not an unrelated store volume. Add `REBAR_GATE_MIN_FREE_GIB` (default 2 GiB, independently documented because this is a hard pre-clone admission floor while existing janitor watermarks are cleanup targets). Check the target volume before both relevant materialization paths: (1) `src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py` immediately before its `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="reviewbot-")` / `gc.clone_change_ref(...)` path, using `tempfile.gettempdir()` as the measured target volume; and (2) `src/rebar/_snapshot/repo_snapshot.py` / `src/rebar/llm/gate_source.py` before attested snapshot materialization, using the snapshot store path as the measured target volume.

If the target volume is below the floor, do not start the clone. For the Gerrit review-bot path, synthesize a decision with at least `verdict="BLOCK"`, `gap_reason="low-disk"`, and a `message` whose first line uses the existing tag grammar. Define `_TAG_SUFFIXES["low-disk"] = "BLOCK — coverage-gap (low-disk)"` in `src/rebar/review_bot/adapter.py`; the message first line must therefore be `[LLM-Review: BLOCK — coverage-gap (low-disk)] ...` so `src/rebar/review_bot/retrigger.py` can continue parsing via the existing `coverage-gap (<reason>)` grammar unless tests prove a classifier extension is required.

Add `low-disk` to `adapter.RETRYABLE_GAP_REASONS` so the under-budget case routes through ADR 0069's existing `_handle_retryable_gap` bounded vote-less deferral. In `src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py`, `_handle_retryable_gap` must gain an explicit low-disk arm: while under budget it defers vote-less exactly like other retryable gaps; when the per-revision low-disk budget is exhausted, it returns/logs a distinct no-vote exhausted-deferral result (for example `status="deferred-exhausted"`, `gap_reason="low-disk"`) and leaves Gerrit labels unchanged. It must skip the existing exhausted-budget fail-closed `LLM-Review -1`, skip `append_retries_exhausted_note`, and skip the `VOTER_ERROR` escalation for low-disk only. Existing fail-closed exhaustion behavior remains unchanged for genuine non-low-disk review errors/coverage gaps. Update `docs/adr/0069-retryable-coverage-gap-bounded-deferral.md`, `docs/adr/0077-code-review-voter-four-pass-rewire.md`, `docs/review-policy.md`, and `src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md` to document the `low-disk` vocabulary and special terminal no-vote semantics.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Under an induced acute-pressure condition (root used-% at or above `DISK_PRESSURE_HARD_PCT`) with enough reclaimable build-cache excess above the warm keep, automated reclaim runs the emergency keep→0 builder prune, measures `bytes_freed > 0`, logs the measured bytes, and the fixture returns root use below the soft `DISK_PRESSURE_PCT`; proof: RED/GREEN tests in `tests/unit/test_autodeploy_prune.py` and/or `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_disk_pressure.py` assert before/after measurement rather than an invocation marker.
- [ ] At normal disk levels below `DISK_PRESSURE_HARD_PCT`, `prune_docker_caches()` preserves steady-state warm-cache behavior by continuing to use `--keep-storage "$BUILD_CACHE_KEEP"`; proof: focused regression test in `tests/unit/test_autodeploy_prune.py`.
- [ ] When free disk on the review-bot clone target volume is below `REBAR_GATE_MIN_FREE_GIB`, `src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py` defers the review as retryable and vote-less through ADR 0069 instead of creating the clone; proof: unit/integration test simulates low free space and asserts no clone/vote is attempted.
- [ ] If the low-disk retry budget is exhausted, the terminal result remains no-vote/labels-unchanged rather than `LLM-Review -1`; proof: focused voter test contrasts `gap_reason="low-disk"` with an ordinary `gap_reason="review-error"` exhaustion path.
- [ ] When free disk on the attested snapshot-store volume is below `REBAR_GATE_MIN_FREE_GIB`, snapshot materialization aborts before clone with a retryable low-disk condition rather than ENOSPC; proof: focused test around `src/rebar/_snapshot/repo_snapshot.py` / `src/rebar/llm/gate_source.py`.
- [ ] The low-disk admission-control condition is observably distinct from a genuine coverage/review error by using `gap_reason="low-disk"`, the literal documented suffix `BLOCK — coverage-gap (low-disk)`, and tests contrasting low-disk deferral with an ordinary non-low-disk coverage gap.
- [ ] Portability is preserved: reclaim/admission logic is in-process/operation-linked and has no dependency on a specific CI provider; proof: implementation uses shell/Python filesystem checks and existing rebar gate paths only.

## Testing / Verification

Run, at minimum, with the worktree virtualenv first on PATH:

- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/test_autodeploy_prune.py tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_disk_pressure.py -q`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest <focused low-disk review admission/voter tests> -q`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck`

## File impact

- `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` — hard pressure tier and measured build-cache reclaim.
- `tests/unit/test_autodeploy_prune.py` and `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_disk_pressure.py` — RED/GREEN coverage for hard vs normal pressure behavior.
- `src/rebar/_snapshot/janitor.py`, `src/rebar/_snapshot/repo_snapshot.py`, `src/rebar/llm/gate_source.py` — target-volume admission helper and snapshot materialization guard.
- `src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py`, `src/rebar/review_bot/adapter.py`, `src/rebar/review_bot/retrigger.py`, `docs/review-policy.md`, `src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md`, `docs/adr/0069-retryable-coverage-gap-bounded-deferral.md`, `docs/adr/0077-code-review-voter-four-pass-rewire.md`, and focused tests — ADR 0069 retryable vote-less low-disk deferral routing, explicit exhausted-budget no-vote branch, tag vocabulary, and documentation.

## Provenance

Discovered during the 2026-09-01 review-bot outage triage. Related closed tickets: 9bc0-1200, 28f9-535c, e2c5-f09b, 2731-4c53, 3a52-2d79, 7a41-95f4.
